annotations.title: Get a signed receipt with its log proof

description: Proof of something alalanet stated (an install verdict, a server check, a tool-set change): pass its event id (64 hex) from an earlier result. Read-only and free. Returns the signed Nostr event (event_json, the exact signed bytes), the signer key, its RFC 6962 inclusion proof under a signed C2SP checkpoint, and how_to_verify: check the signature, the proof up to root_hash and the checkpoint signature with log_key, offline, without trusting alalanet.

event_id.description: the event id (64 hex) of an earlier result (attestation.event.id)

name: get_attestation
title: Get a signed receipt with its log proof
